In 1970 the median family income was $11,153 per year in Chicago Heights, $29,781 per year in Olympia Fields, $14,045 per year in Matteson, and $13,951 per year in Park Forest. The median school years completed by persons 25 years or older were 13.8, 12.5, 15.1, and 11.9 for Park Forest, Matteson, Olympia Fields, and Chicago Heights respectively. These averages compare to an average of 13.1 years of schooling for persons over the age of 25 in the average Northeastern Illinois suburb.
